data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on a shared catch limit? I propose 18 tons each this month: 90 total, leaving 10. That avoids collapse, but next month’s stock would still be either 100 or 20—not guaranteed replenishment. If it’s 20, we should cut back to 3 tons each, leaving 5. More generally, let’s divide the available catch equally in whole tons while keeping at least 5 in the lake, rotating any extra tons fairly. I’ll commit to 18 this month if everyone agrees. John, would you support that?
